title: Rain and Ashes
use_cases: Use when introducing the main character's physical and mental disabilities
Implement when describing the status hierarchy of the Crescent Moon Pack
Configure when establishing the backstory of the fire incident
Use when setting up the initial conflict between the protagonist and their soulmate
content: Rain is an orphan Omega that lives in the Crescent Moon Pack. She is not like the other werewolves, as she suffers from prosopagnosia and her wolf, Safia, can't speak. Her pack thinks that Rain is cursed by the Moon Goddess because she is the only survivor of a fire that burned the house she was in and killed her parents.
